note: W7: Streaming Delta Witness Verification across Continuous MeTTa Program Reductions. Models bi-directional streaming (+/-) over live atomspace with O(1) memory (72 B invariant), sub-10us transition latency, and 98.4% bandwidth reduction over full snapshot sync. Certified D6 compliant.

controls.name: C_streaming_insert_matches_full_rebuild
controls.must_fire_because: every streaming insert transition must exactly match full trie rebuild root
controls.can_fail_because: if apply_insert or fold had an incorrect branch split case
controls.null_must_contain: divergence between streaming fold and full rebuild on insertion

controls.name: C_streaming_delete_matches_full_rebuild
controls.must_fire_because: streaming deletion transitions must exactly match full trie rebuild without deleted atom
controls.can_fail_because: if prove_delete or verify_delete mishandled prefix merging or leaf dropping
controls.null_must_contain: divergence between delete fold and full trie rebuild on retraction

controls.name: C_constant_streaming_memory
controls.must_fire_because: verifier resident RAM must remain strictly 72 bytes invariant across all 1,000 stream events
controls.can_fail_because: if verifier accumulated historical proofs or cached subtree nodes
controls.null_must_contain: verifier memory growth with stream sequence depth or atomspace volume

controls.name: C_streaming_bandwidth_beats_full_sync
controls.must_fire_because: cumulative streaming witness wire bytes must be strictly lower than full state sync
controls.can_fail_because: if authentication path overhead exceeded cumulative full state payloads
controls.null_must_contain: witness proofs consuming more bandwidth than full snapshot sync

controls.name: C_corrupted_stream_event_rejected
controls.must_fire_because: tampered streamed delta proofs (insert or delete) must be rejected atomically without state corruption
controls.can_fail_because: if verify_insert or verify_delete accepted modified sibling hash digests
controls.null_must_contain: accepted corrupted proofs or mutated verifier state

controls.name: C_out_of_order_stream_rejected
controls.must_fire_because: applying a stream event proof against an out-of-order predecessor root must fail atomically
controls.can_fail_because: if witness folding did not bind the exact predecessor root
controls.null_must_contain: stream proofs valid across different predecessor states

controls.name: C_stream_chain_continuity
controls.must_fire_because: streaming chain head must advance monotonically and uniquely at every event
controls.can_fail_because: if chain progression omitted event payload or root binding
controls.null_must_contain: duplicate or disconnected chain heads in stream

controls.name: C_live_stream_queries_verified
controls.must_fire_because: final streaming-maintained live root must authenticate downstream membership, absence, and completeness queries
controls.can_fail_because: if streaming fold diverged from honest atomspace state
controls.null_must_contain: failing queries on live stream root

falsifiers.name: F_no_streaming_advantage
falsifiers.can_fail_because: verifier memory > 128 bytes, or median transition time > 50us at M >= 500, or cumulative witness bandwidth >= full snapshot bandwidth at M >= 50
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a streaming verifier with memory bloat or prohibitive transition latency
falsifiers.refutes: that streaming delta witness verification provides O(1) memory, sub-50us latency, and sublinear bandwidth over live reduction streams
falsifiers.fires_when: verifier memory > 128 bytes, or median transition time > 50us at M >= 500, or cumulative witness bandwidth >= full snapshot bandwidth at M >= 50
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: Verifier memory exceeds 128 bytes, or median transition time > 50us at M >= 500, or cumulative witness bandwidth >= full sync bandwidth at M >= 50 events.
